title: VAT E-Invoice Mandatory Fields and Format

fields.label: Document Title
fields.description: The document must be clearly identified as a 'Tax Invoice', 'VAT Invoice', or 'Invoice'

fields.label: Invoice Number
fields.description: A unique, sequential invoice identification number

fields.label: Invoice Date
fields.description: The date the invoice was issued

fields.label: Supplier / Seller Name
fields.description: Full legal name of the supplier or service provider

fields.label: Supplier Address
fields.description: Business address of the supplier

fields.label: Supplier VAT Registration Number
fields.description: VAT registration number issued by the Inland Revenue Department
fields.formatHint: Typically starts with country prefix or IRD number

fields.label: Supplier TIN
fields.description: Taxpayer Identification Number (if different from VAT number)

fields.label: Customer / Buyer Name
fields.description: Full name of the customer or purchasing business

fields.label: Customer Address
fields.description: Business or residential address of the customer

fields.label: Customer VAT Registration Number
fields.description: VAT registration number of the customer (required for B2B transactions)

fields.label: Description of Goods / Services
fields.description: Clear description of each item or service supplied

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: Quantity of each item or extent of service

fields.label: Unit Price
fields.description: Price per unit (exclusive of VAT)

fields.label: Line Total
fields.description: Total amount for each line item (quantity × unit price)

fields.label: Subtotal (excl. VAT)
fields.description: Sum of all line totals before VAT

fields.label: VAT Rate(s)
fields.description: Applicable VAT rate(s) — standard rate is 18% as of 2024

fields.label: VAT Amount
fields.description: Total VAT charged on the invoice

fields.label: Total Amount (incl. VAT)
fields.description: Grand total payable — subtotal plus VAT

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency in which the invoice is denominated
fields.formatHint: ISO code (LKR, USD, EUR, etc.) or symbol

fields.label: Discounts / Allowances
fields.description: Any discounts, allowances, or price reductions applied

fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.description: Payment due date or terms (e.g. Net 30)

fields.label: Date of Supply
fields.description: Date when goods/services were supplied (if different from invoice date)

fields.label: Export Indicator
fields.description: If the supply is an export, must be marked as zero-rated with destination country

notes: All amounts must be clearly denominated with currency indicated.
Invoice numbers must be sequential with no gaps.
Credit/debit notes must reference the original invoice number.
Simplified invoices are permitted for supplies below LKR 5,000.
E-invoices must be in a machine-readable format (PDF/A or structured data).
Records must be retained for a minimum of 5 years.
